lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，我飘过低草。
lines.en: Wings opening and closing, I drift over the low grass.
I fly the wood's edge, hunting lily of the valley.
A flash of orange in the sunlight.
I don't fly straight; the wind pushes me.
I skim just over the flower tips.

lines.zh: 我抬高了半尺，避开灌木。
lines.en: I lift half a foot to clear the shrub.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得很慢，可我不掉。
lines.en: My wings beat slowly, and yet I don't fall.
I settle on a leaf and rise again.
I shuttle between two patches of flowers.

lines.zh: 太阳很好，我飞得高一点。
lines.en: Good sun, so I fly a little higher.
I swerve around a web — barely.
I ride the warm air upward.

lines.zh: 翅膀一顿一顿，影子跟着跳。
lines.en: My wings beat in stops, and the shadow skips along.
I check every flower along the way.
A few grains of wing dust fall.

lines.zh: 我飞得低，怕风把我带走。
lines.en: I fly low, afraid the wind will carry me off.
I rest on a flower with wings closed.

lines.zh: 翅膀慢慢开合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My wings open and close like breathing.
I'm basking to warm up.

lines.zh: 林子里有猫叫，我触角转了转。
lines.en: A cat calls in the woods; my antennae swivel.
The dew's too heavy for me to fly.

lines.zh: 我停在一片叶子的背面。
lines.en: I rest on the underside of a leaf.
I hear a cat somewhere far off.
Wind sweeps the lily of the valley; I grip with my feet.

lines.zh: 这朵铃兰的蜜不多，够我一口。
lines.en: Not much nectar in this lily of the valley, but enough for one sip.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一片叶。
lines.en: I hold still and pass for a leaf.

lines.zh: 太阳挪了位置，我跟着转。
lines.en: The sun moved and I turned with it.
There's a nick in my wing's edge.
You're so tall I have to look up.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的肩，绕了半圈。
lines.en: I follow your shoulder in a half circle.

lines.zh: 你一俯身，整朵花都暗了。
lines.en: You lean down and the whole flower goes dark.
I don't fear people; people plant flowers.
I land on your shoulder for an instant.
Your hat is almost a flower's colour.

lines.zh: 我在你面前停住，翅膀合上。
lines.en: I stop before you and close my wings.
Did you plant these flowers?

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我就落下来。
lines.en: Hold still and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我停在你的指节上歇脚。
lines.en: I rest on your knuckle for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀皱着，飞不动了。
lines.en: My wing is crumpled; I can't fly.
I drop into the grass and roll over.
Wing dust scatters everywhere.
I push myself up with my legs.
That knocked me sideways.
I stay low; I can't climb.
One of my wings won't move.
I stop to rest a moment.
I still want to get airborne again.
I curl up as small as I can.
Lily of the valley — I see it.
This bloom is full of nectar.
I'm off to it at once.
Don't pick it; let me feed first.
I land on a petal, light-footed.
One feed lasts me a long while.
The scent is strongest here.
I uncurl my proboscis and drink.
I've found another one.
The wind brought the scent over.
You moved and I was nearly swept away.
The knock set my wings crooked.
I fall to the ground and lift off again.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的指缝滑出去。
lines.en: I slip out along the gap between your fingers.
That knocked the wind out of me.

lines.zh: 我从你袖口擦过，掉了几粒粉。
lines.en: I brush past your cuff and shed a few grains of dust.

lines.zh: 我落在草上，翅膀还开着。
lines.en: I land in the grass with wings still spread.
One knock and I shed some wing dust.
Don't stand in front of the flowers.

lines.zh: 被你碰掉一层粉，我照样飞。
lines.en: You knocked off some dust; I fly anyway.

lines.zh: 另一片翅膀在花上等着。
lines.en: Another pair of wings waits on the bloom.
We circle the same flower.
I settle beside it, very close.
Two pairs of wings open and close together.
The wind pushes us together.

lines.zh: 我们沿着同一片林子飞。
lines.en: We fly along the same stretch of wood.
I loop once above it.
There are flowers enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们一起升高，又一起落下。
lines.en: We rise together and drop together.

lines.zh: 天色暗了，我们各自回叶上。
lines.en: At dusk we each go back to our leaves.

lines.zh: 我在花上停了一下，又走。
lines.en: I pause on the bloom, then move on.
I test this petal underfoot.
I get pollen dusted on me.
A drop on the leaf; I go around it.
I linger at the edge of a dewdrop.
I catch a falling petal.
A grain of sand is stuck to my foot.
I kick it off.

lines.zh: 我在蛛网上看到一只翅膀。
lines.en: There's a wing on a spiderweb.
I fly there and back.
A grass tip just moved.
I fold my wings narrow.
That shadow isn't a bird; too small.
I climb a level higher.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，试它会不会动。
lines.en: I circle it to see if it moves.
I duck behind a flower.
I've picked that leaf.
I need to get out of here.
Its eyes are following me.
I'm going higher.
I circle in, tighter each turn.
When it moves, I jink away.
I bob high and low; it can't catch me.

lines.zh: 风帮我往旁边推了一尺。
lines.en: The wind carried me a foot aside.

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖飞，最快的线。
lines.en: I take the fastest line, skimming the grass.

lines.zh: 另一对翅膀在花丛后响。
lines.en: Another pair of wings sounds behind the flowers.
It turns too slowly.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树之间穿过去。
lines.en: I fly between two trees.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看它还敢不敢。
lines.en: I stop and see if it still dares.
I won't enter that shade.
I've no other way; I ram it.
My wings beat until it squints.
I strike with my whole body.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可我尽力了。
lines.en: It's light, but it's all I have.
Its hand flinched and I'm away.
Wing dust puffs into its face.
I hit again.
I'm behind it.
I land on its hand and lift off.
My wing bent at the corner.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀展开，第一下有点抖。
lines.en: My wings open and the first beat is shaky.
I dry my wings a while.
The wood's edge surrounds me.
I can see lily of the valley.
I fly up, then stop.
The air is warm; flying feels good.

lines.zh: 我绕着出生点飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the spot where I began.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在林子里很显眼。
lines.en: My colour stands out in the wood.
I land on the first flower.
There are plenty of flowers ahead.

lines.zh: 火一过，翅膀的边就卷了。
lines.en: Fire passes and my wing edges curl.
I hit the ground with wings spread flat.

lines.zh: 水把我的翅膀粘在一起。
lines.en: Water glues my wings together.
The blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭的尾羽差点碰上我。
lines.en: An arrow's fletching nearly clipped me.
My wings won't do what I tell them.
I haven't the strength to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 白光晃过，我翅膀停在半空。
lines.en: White light flashes and my wings stall mid-beat.
The air's gone and I just fall.
